xref.title: Numerous Collaborations and Writing Credits
xref.body: Weezer, or its members, have engaged in a large number of collaborations, guest appearances, and writing credits with various artists. These include A.W. Nation, Billy Talent, Todd Rundgren, Panic! at the Disco, and even The Muppets, with approximately three dozen such collaborative songs identified. "There are all the guest appearances and writing credits unrecorded by A.W. Nation, Billy Talent, Todd Rungren, Panic of the Disco, and even The Muppets."

xref.title: Proto-Goth/Death Metal Theory
xref.body: A theory suggests that Paul Williams, through his work on the 1974 film 'Phantom of the Paradise,' may have accidentally invented goth or death metal music, preceding their recognized emergence in the late 1970s and mid-1980s, respectively. "Can we say that Paul Williams, the guy who wrote songs for the muppets, accidentally invented both?"
